# National Car Rental

> > Fast and convenient car rental services with the Emerald Club loyalty program across 1,500+ global locations including Australia, Argentina, UAE, and worldwide airports and city centers.

National Car Rental operates as part of the Enterprise Holdings family (alongside Enterprise and Alamo brands), offering vehicle rentals at airports and downtown locations with specialized policies for cross-border travel, age requirements, and after-hours service.

## Key Topics

- Emerald Club loyalty program
- Enterprise Holdings partnership
- Cross-border rental restrictions
- Age requirements and additional driver fees
- Airport pickup and after-hours service
- Australia car hire (Queensland, Western Australia, Tasmania, Northern Territory)
- Argentina rental locations
- International location network
- Rental policies and terms
- Remote area restrictions (Cape York, Old Telegraph Track, Fraser Island, Bloomfield Track)

## Getting Started

- [Fast & Convenient Car Rental at 1,500+ Locations | National Car Rental](http://nationalcar.com/): Homepage featuring Emerald Club loyalty program and 1,500+ rental locations
- [Fast & Convenient Car Rental at 1,500+ Locations](https://legacy.nationalcar.com/): Legacy booking interface for National Car Rental reservations and deals
- [International Car Rental Locations | National Car Rental](https://www.nationalcar.com/en/car-rental-locations.html): Global location finder covering US, Canada, UK, France and worldwide
